changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 18 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000020).

Withheld after the final research pass: platform 0–1's middle node isn't on the walking graph and two amenities are unreachable. The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.
